#   ConfigServer Threat Database › FTP › 1 Day
#   File Transfer Protocol
#   
#   These blocklists are maintained directly by ConfigServer and are
#   compiled from connection attempts against our FTP honeypots, as
#   well as unauthorized attempts targeting FTP services we operate.
#   
#   The threat feeds capture malicious FTP activity across exposed
#   internet-facing infrastructure.
#   
#   IP addresses included in this dataset have been observed attempting
#   actions such as brute force authentication, credential stuffing,
#   directory probing, and automated scanning against FTP services.
#   
#   Blocklists prefixed with `_1d` represent activity observed within
#   the most recent 24-hour period and reflect confirmed FTP connection
#   attempts during that window, treated as high-confidence indicators
#   of malicious behavior.
#   
#   Blocklists prefixed with `_365d` are cumulative datasets covering
#   a one-year period and may include a higher rate of false positives
#   due to IP reuse, NAT, and infrastructure changes across providers.
